sources.label: PowerPyx: GTA 6 all challenges guide
sources.note: All 80 challenges and requirements, Progress > Challenges, available from the start. Nov 18-19, 2026. Trusted source.

items.name: Speed Kills
items.req: Take down 3 enemies inside 30 seconds.

items.name: Melee Combat
items.req: Kill or knock out 5 enemies in a row with melee attacks, without dying.

items.name: Explosive Combat
items.req: Kill or injure 3 enemies with a single explosive.

items.name: Headshots
items.req: Land 4 headshot kills in one use of combat focus.

items.name: Drive-Bys
items.req: Kill 5 enemies from a vehicle within 1 minute, without getting out.

items.name: Stealth Sniping
items.req: Kill 7 enemies who haven't spotted you with a scoped sniper rifle, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Incendiary
items.req: Kill or injure 5 enemies with fire within 15 seconds.

items.name: Revolver Headshots
items.req: Get 6 headshot kills with a revolver without reloading or switching weapons.

items.name: Long-Range Sniping
items.req: Kill 3 enemies within 10 seconds with a scoped sniper rifle from 300 ft or more.

items.name: High Explosive
items.req: Kill or injure 8 enemies with explosives within 20 seconds, without taking damage.

items.name: Mugging
items.req: Rob 5 pedestrians.

items.name: Stick Ups
items.req: Hold up 3 stores in a single in-game day, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Carjacking
items.req: In one day, carjack 3 vehicles and drive each to a Pay 'n' Spray, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Mugging Spree
items.req: Take $500 in cash off pedestrians in one day, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Cop Car Theft
items.req: Stay wanted for 5 minutes while driving a stolen police vehicle.

items.name: Cop Weapon Theft
items.req: Grab a weapon from the trunk of 5 different police vehicles, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Stick Up Spree
items.req: Hold up 2 stores in each of the 5 counties within 20 minutes, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Cop Tow
items.req: Tow a police vehicle with someone inside for 1 mile without stopping.

items.name: Carjacking Spree
items.req: Within 30 minutes, register or respray stolen vehicles from 10 different manufacturers at a Pay 'n' Spray, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: Carjacking Pro
items.req: Make $100,000 in one day selling stolen vehicles to a fence or a Pay 'n' Spray, without dying or being arrested.

items.name: WAiNK Locations
items.req: Scan 4 landmarks, curiosities or sculptures with WAiNK.

items.name: Skyscrapers
items.req: Get to the top of the 5 tallest skyscrapers in Vice-Dale County.

items.name: Collectible Cards
items.req: Find 3 collectible cards in each of the 5 counties.

items.name: Encyclopedia
items.req: Discover 100 animals, vehicles and weapons.

items.name: Underwater Discoveries
items.req: Find and explore 25 unusual sights on the ocean floor.

items.name: Rail Tour
items.req: In one day, ride a train for 1 mile in each of the 5 counties, without skipping the ride.

items.name: Underwater Treasures
items.req: Find 85 underwater treasures.

items.name: Black Hole Wrecks
items.req: Find all 11 black hole wrecks.

items.name: Road Trip
items.req: Visit every city and town in Leonida in one day, only leaving the vehicle to refuel.

items.name: Helipad Flyovers
items.req: Fly over all 41 helipads in Vice City and Vice Beach at 100 ft or lower, within 10 minutes.

items.name: Gym Member
items.req: Join any gym.

items.name: Foot Travel
items.req: Walk 5 miles in one day.

items.name: Pro Cyclist
items.req: Cycle 15 miles in one day.

items.name: Pro Swimmer
items.req: Swim 3 miles in one day.

items.name: Balanced Workout
items.req: Use every type of gym equipment in one day.

items.name: Strength Regime
items.req: Keep Jason and Lucia both at Strength Level 4 for 5 days in a row.

items.name: Cardio Regime
items.req: Keep Jason and Lucia both at Cardio Level 4 for 5 days in a row.

items.name: Waning Sands Run
items.req: Go on foot from the gate of the Tip pier to Waning Sands within 13 minutes, without taking damage.

items.name: Tequesta Swim
items.req: Swim from Tequesta Retreat to Starfish Island within 15 minutes.

items.name: Southwind Cycle
items.req: Ride a bicycle from Williams Guest House to Chicky's Tiki Bar in Southwind within 22 minutes, without falling off.

items.name: Vehicle Modder
items.req: Buy 5 modifications at a mod shop.

items.name: Grocery Shopper
items.req: Spend more than $250 at convenience or liquor stores in one day.

items.name: Well Armed
items.req: Buy 3 sidearms and 3 longarms at Ammu-Nation.

items.name: Well Groomed
items.req: Spend more than $1,000 at barbers, hairdressers or salons.

items.name: Stylishly Armed
items.req: Buy cosmetic upgrades for 5 sidearms and 5 longarms at Ammu-Nation.

items.name: Well Dressed
items.req: Spend more than $5,000 on clothes.

items.name: Custom Ride
items.req: Spend more than $20,000 in one visit to a mod shop.

items.name: Heavily Armed
items.req: Spend more than $50,000 at Ammu-Nation in total.

items.name: Serious Modder
items.req: Spend more than $125,000 at mod shops in total.

items.name: Nest Egg
items.req: Have $1,500,000 in your BuckMe checking account.

items.name: Basketball Rookie
items.req: Score at 3 different hoops in one day.

items.name: Golf Rookie
items.req: Play 18 holes at King Gator or Frontier Adventure Golf within 30 minutes, finishing 3 under par or better.

items.name: Basketball Streak
items.req: Make 10 shots in a row within 2 minutes.

items.name: Pool Streak
items.req: Win games of pool at 3 different places in one day, without losing or quitting.

items.name: Basketball Tour
items.req: Score a shot in every county.

items.name: Golf Pro
items.req: Play 18 holes at King Gator and at Frontier Adventure Golf in the same day, at par or better on both.

items.name: Triple Bank
items.req: Bounce the cue ball off 3 cushions before potting a ball.

items.name: Basketball Pro
items.req: Score at all 100 hoops in Leonida.

items.name: 8-Ball Break
items.req: Win a game of pool by potting the 8-ball on the break.

items.name: Double Hole In One
items.req: Get two holes in one back to back in the same round at King Gator or Frontier Adventure Golf.

items.name: Alligator Kills
items.req: Kill 3 wild alligators.

items.name: Big Fish
items.req: Catch a fish weighing 20 lb or more.

items.name: Marksman
items.req: Win a medal at both shooting ranges in one day.

items.name: Catch of the Day
items.req: Catch 3 fish with every type of lure in one day.

items.name: Zoologist
items.req: Study 20 animal species through binoculars.

items.name: Angler
items.req: Catch 4 different species of fish within 6 minutes.

items.name: Pro Marksman
items.req: Earn gold in 3 different shooting range events in a row, without failing or quitting.

items.name: Hunting Spree
items.req: Kill a boar, a rattlesnake and a panther within 15 minutes, without taking damage from people or animals.

items.name: Pro Angler
items.req: Catch every species of fish.

items.name: Legendary Hunter
items.req: Kill all 8 unique animals.

items.name: Vehicle Discovery
items.req: Discover 6 different vehicles. Scanning them with WAiNK counts.

items.name: Wheelie
items.req: Hold a wheelie for 0.25 miles.

items.name: Winning Streak
items.req: Win 3 races: one in a muscle car, one in a sports car and one in a supercar.

items.name: Throttled
items.req: Stay above 100 mph in a motor vehicle for 2 minutes.

items.name: Drawbridge Jump
items.req: Clear a drawbridge by more than 100 ft three times, without getting out of the vehicle.

items.name: Top Speed
items.req: Hit 175 mph in a car, truck or motorbike.

items.name: Train Landing
items.req: Land a plane on a moving train without wrecking it.

items.name: Oceanarium Jump
items.req: Jump from an aircraft at 0.5 miles up or higher and parachute into the orca or dolphin tank at the Vice City Oceanarium, without dying.

items.name: Rally Winner
items.req: Win 3 races in a row in one day at Thrillbilly Mud Club, Gellhorn International Raceway and Boone Speedway, without quitting or restarting.

items.name: Train Jump
items.req: Jump a motorbike 75 ft or more and land on a moving train, twice within 20 minutes.
